newsitem.title: USA: Gentex Q1 net rises on record sales.
newsitem.headline: Gentex Q1 net rises on record sales.

text.p: Gentex Corp said Monday its earnings in the first quarter ended March 31 climbed in part because of record sales in the period.

The company, which makes parts for auto manufacturers, reported net income of $7.4 million, or $0.21 a share, versus $3.3 million, or $0.10, in the same period last year. The company said 1996 results included a $4 million patent litigation settlement that reduced its earnings by $0.10 a share.
Gentex said sales rose to $41.9 million from $35.9 million in the first quarter of 1996.
The company added there is continued price pressure from automakers, and it does not expect the near-term situation to change.
Gentex shares were down 3/4 Monday at 19-3/4.
